definitions.explanation: rigorous practice or training to strengthen body, mind, or skills

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{体|からだ}を{鍛錬|たんれん}する。
examples.english: I train my body every day.

examples.japanese: {精神|せいしん}の{鍛錬|たんれん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
{長年|ながねん}の{鍛錬|たんれん}によって{技|わざ}を{磨|みが}いた。
examples.english: I polished my skills through years of training.

notes:
USAGE:
- {体|からだ}を{鍛錬|たんれん}する (to train one's body)
- {精神|せいしん}の{鍛錬|たんれん} (mental discipline)
- {日々|ひび}の{鍛錬|たんれん} (daily training)

NUANCE:
Implies serious, rigorous training with the goal of strengthening or perfecting. Often used in martial arts, sports, and personal development contexts.

ETYMOLOGY:
Originally referred to forging metal (tempering). The meaning extended to forging/tempering the body and mind.

RELATED:
- {訓練|くんれん} (training, drill - more general)
- {修練|しゅうれん} (training, discipline - similar)
- {鍛|きた}える (to forge, to train - verb)
